stories.title: Automated reporting at a paper mill
stories.body: As a Process Engineer Intern at Rayonier Advanced Materials, I automated Proficy data visualization using VBA-enhanced specification sheets and designed an Excel-based chemical inventory system. Together these cut manual reporting effort, improved tracking accuracy, and reduced material waste on the manufacturing lines.

stories.title: Cut utility consumption with data dashboards
stories.body: At PepsiCo (Frito-Lay), I built dashboards and tracking tools to monitor daily utility consumption — water, energy, nitrogen, and gas — and surface inefficiencies. I delivered weekly and monthly reports to corporate leadership that directly informed the facility's sustainability planning and resource-conservation upgrades.

stories.title: Led a 20+ person packaging team
stories.body: As a Packaging Department Supervisor at PepsiCo, I managed a team of 20+ operators while hitting productivity and safety targets. By introducing optimized labor and scheduling practices and coordinating across maintenance and logistics, I improved shift efficiency and reduced costs.

stories.title: Shipped a real-time ML classifier
stories.body: For a computer-technologies project, I developed and deployed a real-time support vector machine classifier that distinguishes live basketball games from commercials using video frame analysis with an on-screen overlay. I validated it with cross-validation and standard classification metrics on real-world footage.

stories.title: Coordinated a multi-trade construction site
stories.body: As a Field Coordinator at EllisDon, I coordinated concrete pours and multi-trade scheduling across multiple floors and towers, and streamlined project reporting with advanced Excel/VBA. I worked with project teams to spot workflow bottlenecks and resequence trades to keep the build on schedule.
